 Prince Mishra joins ZEE5 as Senior Vice President - Creative
 Prince Mishra joins ZEE5 as Senior Vice President - Creative
 Mishra has over 14 years of experience spanning films, advertising, television, radio and OTT 
 by
 e4m Staff
 Published: 
 Nov 6, 2026 1:21 PM 
 | 
 1 min read 
 Follow Us 
 Prince Mishra joins ZEE5 as Senior Vice President - Creative, bringing over 14 years of experience across films, advertising, television, radio and OTT.
 Most recently with Prime Video, he has worked across creative strategy, brand building and content marketing, with experience spanning content launches and integrated campaigns.
 --> 
 --> 
 At ZEE5, he will focus on strengthening the brand proposition, deepening consumer affinity and translating its diverse content portfolio into compelling audience connections as the platform advances its next phase of growth.
